_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil statistics (0/50 windows with ±2+ point moves) and the analyst's 0/15 breaker record make HOLD the skilled call, while the forward phase leans Disbelief (one rung up) if any catalyst breaks the trap — but no catalyst is currently visible.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both place current phase at Denial, but the analyst explicitly forward-calls Disbelief while the narrative implies upward resolution without naming the rung; the analyst's structural skepticism about the August analog creates tension with the narrative's more optimistic framing
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows rise above 30 with BTC 30-day momentum holding above 50 and funding staying below 60
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 80 with DXY weakness reversing below 50 and BTC exchange reserves dropping sharply (distribution into risk-off)
